description: This file contains client-side JavaScript code for the 'Bank' doctype in ERPNext, handling form events, dynamic field updates, and Plaid integration for bank account linking.

classes.name: refreshPlaidLink
classes.description: Class managing Plaid link initialization, script loading, and success/error handling.

methods.name: add_fields_to_mapping_table
methods.description: Populates options for bank transaction fields in the form.

methods.name: refreshPlaidLink.constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Plaid link with access token and URL.

methods.name: refreshPlaidLink.init_config
methods.description: Fetches environment and link token, then initializes Plaid.

methods.name: refreshPlaidLink.get_link_token_for_update
methods.description: Retrieves the link token for updating Plaid connection.

methods.name: refreshPlaidLink.init_plaid
methods.description: Loads the Plaid script and sets up the link handler.

methods.name: refreshPlaidLink.onScriptLoaded
methods.description: Creates Plaid link handler upon script load.
